SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1, Special Branch
REPORT
Date June 20, 1935.

Subject The National Economic Council of the National Government

Made by D.P.S. Lockwood Forwarded by A. Gruk cot

In 1933 the National Government formed the National
Economic Council. This Council is directly responsible to
the Government for the investigation of any new projects of
a constructional nature, which are to be financed by the
Government. All projected schemes have to be inquired
into from the economical as well as the practicable point
of view, and all recommendations are submitted to the
Government for a final decision.

The National Economic Council is controlled by a
standing committee composed of the following members :-
Chairman : Mr. T.V. Soong, Ex-Minister of Finance.
Gen. Chiang Kai-shek, President of the
Military Committee.
Waung Ching-wei, President of the Administrative
Yuan.
Dr. H.H. Kung, Vice President of the
Administrative Yuan and Minister of
Finance.
Dr. Sun Fo, President of the Legislative Yuan.
Secretary General Zing Feng.
The following also serve as members of the ordinary
committee :-
Minister of Interior.
Minister of Finance.
Minister of Railways.
Minister of Communications.
Minister of Industry.
Minister of Education.
Chief of the Health Department.

报告
日期：1935年6月20日。

主题：国民政府全国经济委员会

制作人：警务副总监洛克伍德（Lockwood） 转呈人：A. Gruk cot

1933年，国民政府成立了全国经济委员会。该委员会直接对政府负责，调查任何由政府资助的新建工程项目。所有计划方案都必须从经济和可行性角度进行审查，所有建议均提交政府作最终决定。

全国经济委员会由一个常务委员会控制，成员如下：
主席：宋子文先生，前财政部长。
蒋介石将军，军事委员会委员长。
汪精卫，行政院院长。
孔祥熙博士，行政院副院长兼财政部长。
孙科博士，立法院院长。
秘书长：曾丰（音译）。
以下人员亦担任普通委员会委员：
内政部部长。
财政部部长。
铁道部部长。
交通部部长。
实业部部长。
教育部部长。
卫生署署长。

The committee of the National Economic Council
categorised the schemes it would be called upon to investigate
and report, and formed the following sub-organs :-
Industry Research and Investigation Bureau.
Cotton Industry Commission.
Silk Industry Control Committee.
National Provision Control Committee.
Silk Improvement Committee.
Highway Office.
Hygiene Office.
The National Economic Council's committee have
established the offices of two sub-organs, in Shanghai, namely,
the Industry Research and Investigation Bureau, with offices
at Room 361, Hamilton House, Kiangse Road, and the Cotton
Industry Commission situated at No.113 Kiukiang Road.
The Industry Research and Investigation Bureau is in
charge of one named Chang Foh Yung (張福運) and is respon-
sible for the investigation and study of industry throughout
China.
The Cotton Industry Commission is controlled by an
executive committee, under the chairmanship of Chen Kwang Fu,
General Manager of the Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank,
and is responsible for the study of all problems relating
to the cotton industry.
The National Economic Council since its inception has
spent 32 million dollars.

                                J. D. Lockwood.
                                D. P. S.

J. D. G. (Special Branch).

全国经济委员会将其需调查和报告的方案进行分类，并成立了以下下属机构：
工业研究与调查局。
棉业统制委员会。
丝业管制委员会。
全国粮食统制委员会。
蚕丝改良委员会。
公路局。
卫生局。
全国经济委员会已在上海设立了两个下属机构的办事处，即：工业研究与调查局，办公地点位于江西路汉密尔顿大楼361室；棉业统制委员会，位于九江路113号。
工业研究与调查局由一名叫张福运的人负责，负责对中国各地的工业进行调查和研究。
棉业统制委员会由一个执行委员会管理，主席为上海商业储蓄银行总经理陈光甫，负责研究与棉业有关的所有问题。
全国经济委员会自成立以来，已支出3200万美元。

                                J. D. Lockwood.
                                警务副总监

J. D. G. （特科）。
（印：1935年6月25日）
副本发送至 A, D, F & H 科。

Date June 15, 19 35.

Subject Information requested by Miss Hinder for the
information of the National Economic Mission Council
of the National Government.
Made by D.P.S. Lockwood Forwarded by A Grubb Cnt

Herewith statistics of factories and business
houses, with the number of unemployed workers in the
Settlement, which have closed and/or reopened since January
1, 1934, as requested by Miss Hinder for the information of
the Chinese Government's National Economic Council.
An accurate list of new factories recently opened
in the Settlement cannot be given as statistics have not
yet been fully completed. No record is kept of the opening
or closing of business houses, except those independently
supported by their own plants.

F.b. Lockwood.
D. P. S.

D. C. (Special Branch)
I SI
Please supply statistics to Miss Hinder
and endeavour to obtain some literature
about the National Economic Mission.
JWg
15 JUNE 1935
2 Sup/
Statistics were given to Miss Hinder on 15/6/1935
M.O.S.
Lockwood.

兹附上自1934年1月1日以来在租界内关闭和/或重新开业的工厂和商号统计数据，以及失业工人人数，此系应辛德小姐要求，供中国政府全国经济委员会参考。
